## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] `npm run build` passes
- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`) per the DCO
- [ ] No personal or client content added — demo content is fictional, mine, or CC0
- [ ] No secret is exposed in the client bundle (nothing sensitive behind a `VITE_` variable)
- [ ] Any user-facing copy reads clearly to someone who does not write code
